messages:
jordan: FYI - Payments flagged account MER-7741. Multiple chargebacks and a suspicious pattern of promo stacking. Stripe put a provisional payout hold this morning. Need dispute evidence and a recommendation on whether to escalate or release funds.

nina: Can we get the list of chargeback codes and timestamps? Any overlap with coupon usage and duplicate invoices?

jordan: Chargebacks: cb_9a7 (fraudulent), cb_9a8 (product_not_received). Dates: 2026-04-11 to 2026-04-13. Promo codes used: REDWOOD50, SPRING_TRIAL. Invoice refs: INV-2026-9012, INV-2026-9013. Quick txn snapshot: 
```csv
payment_id,amount,currency,created_at,invoice,card_country,bin,ip,promo_used,chargeback
pay_4LmA1,49.00,USD,2026-04-11T11:02:05Z,INV-2026-9012,US,601111,198.51.100.14,REDWOOD50,true
pay_4LmB2,0.00,USD,2026-04-11T11:03:10Z,INV-2026-9012,US,601111,198.51.100.14,SPRING_TRIAL,false
pay_4LmC3,49.00,USD,2026-04-12T09:20:45Z,INV-2026-9013,BR,601111,190.12.5.9,REDWOOD50,true
```

payments-bot: stripe.alert: merchant_hold.created id=mh_7TzK reason="chargeback_velocity" on MER-7741

arthur: Looks like same BIN across disputed txns and an immediate free-trial redemption. AVS mismatch on the BR txn and shipping address absent. I'd flag as high-risk.

nina: We already refunded one txn proactively (pay_4LmB2) because of customer support. We should freeze any live refunds until we collect evidence.

jordan: Agreed. Action list: 1) arthur: gather AVS/CVV, KYC for MER-7741 and merchant-submitted receipts 2) nina: pause refunds and draft the notice to merchant outlining the hold and next steps 3) legal-svc: review chargeback contest strategy for cross-border BIN disputes. Need packet uploaded to Stripe within 7 days.

legal-svc: I'll review. If merchant can provide shipment proof or signed TOS acceptance we may contest product_not_received. For suspected fraud, focus on device fingerprints and billing/shipping consistency.

arthur: Pulling device fingerprint, session logs, and merchant-provided order confirmations. Also checking whether coupons were whitelisted for that merchant or abused via coupon bots. ETA 3 hours.

nina: Drafted merchant notification: "Your payouts are provisionally held due to elevated chargeback activity. Please provide order confirmations, shipment/tracking, and KYC within 72 hours to avoid escalation." Posting in #ops-templates for quick review.

jordan: OK to proceed with hold. I'll set internal hold and notify ops. Keep legal in loop. If merchant supplies valid proofs, we can request Stripe unfreeze.

payments-bot: internal.action: hold_applied merchant=MER-7741 by=jordan case=CASE-2026-10088

nina: Uploading draft evidence bundle to the dispute portal now. Will include CSV export, device logs, merchant receipts (partial), and support ticket summary.

jordan: Thanks. Keep the thread updated. If chargeback ratio crosses 1.5% in the next 24h we escalate to risk leadership.

legal-svc: Noted. I'll prepare a short rebuttal template for product_not_received disputes.

jordan: Closing for now ":lock:" — will reopen if Stripe requires additional documentation.
